data.text: **Qaa'ida (Pages 66–67):** Kisi cheez ki mukammal nafi (**'Koi ... nahin'**) karne ke liye baghair `الْـ` wale ism se pehle **`لَا`** lagaya jata hai, aur us ism ke aakhir par Tanween ke bajaye **sirf ek Zabar (`ـَ`)** aata hai: `رَيْبٌ ← لَا رَيْبَ` (koi shak nahin), `إِكْرَاهٌ ← لَا إِكْرَاهَ فِي الدِّينِ` (deen mein koi zabardasti nahin).

data.text: Kisi bhi zubaan ke jumle samajhne ke liye alfaaz ka jaanna zaroori hai. Bohat se Qur'ani alfaaz seekhne ke baad, ab aap chhote Qur'ani jumle samajhne ke qaabil ho rahe hain. Jaise jaise aap jumle samajhna shuru karenge, zubaan ke qawaid-o-zawabit (Grammar) qudrati taur par khud-ba-khud samajh aane lagenge.
